user.title: Set up Luma Home
user.description: Choose how Luma runs on this screen.

menu_options.streamer: Android TV or Google TV Streamer

webos.title: Set up Luma Home
webos.description: Select the LG webOS TV that has Luma installed. Each TV gets its own pins, controls, voice preferences and wallpaper.

streamer.title: Set up a LumaX Streamer
streamer.description: Select the remote entity from Android TV Remote. In LumaX, connect to this Home Assistant and select the room you create here.

error.not_webostv: Choose a TV from the LG webOS integration.
error.not_android_tv_remote: Choose a remote from the Android TV Remote integration.

init.title: Luma preferences
init.description: Pins, lights, wallpaper images and room widgets are also editable using the Luma Home dashboard card.

data_description.lumax_enabled: Open the optional LumaX app when using the TV’s full Home shortcut. Fall back to the webOS launcher when the Streamer is unavailable.
data_description.lumax_input: The HDMI port on the LG that the Google TV Streamer is plugged into.
